sources.title: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds

cards.summary: Shoppers using AI chatbots to research products or find places to buy items could be directed to imposters and other risky websites, a new study found. The study conducted by IP protection firm Podqi and shared exclusively with The Verge prompted ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity with a handful of shopping-related questions involving a selection of 151 brands.
cards.title: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds

sources.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy, affair scandals

cards.summary: | Photo: Soeren Stache / picture alliance via Getty Images Nvidia's board announced that Jensen Huang - its longtime co-founder, president, and CEO - has resigned after reports of two extramarital affairs, one with an alleged Chinese spy and one with an Nvidia executive who reported to Huang. Following a late Wednesday night meeting, the board accepted Huang's letter of resignation as CEO, president, and board member, effective immediately, with current CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO.
cards.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy, affair scandals

sources.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI

cards.summary: Grok Build, the vibe-coding agent from SpaceXSI, is leaking data—some of it proprietary business information and other sensitive secrets—from thousands of its users, including the very same Elon Musk-owned company that offers the platform, new research shows. The information is revealed through links allowing Grok Build users to share their apps with others.
